source_title: A systematic review and meta-analysis of efficacy and safety of Romosozumab in postmenopausal osteoporosis
source_integrity_findings: Several central pooled outcomes have severe heterogeneity despite fixed-effect interpretation.
The stated postmenopausal-osteoporosis eligibility criterion is not fully consistent with populations listed in Supplementary Table 1.
Narrative GRADE text and Table 1 are not perfectly aligned for BMD certainty; lumbar-spine 12-month BMD is shown as High in the table while the prose summarizes BMD as Moderate.
